## Summary

Adds the experimental CaseGraphen Memory Plane as a derived, evidence-grounded view over the Acceptance Ledger. It ships strict source/claim/query/projection/use-report/index contracts, deterministic temporal and authority governance, read-only CLI/MCP retrieval, and proposal-only curation surfaces.

No Memory Plane command or MCP tool can directly create accepted state, and indexes remain disposable derived data.

## Why

- **Goal:** make coding-agent project memory explainable by source, authority, scope, valid time, review, and conflict state.
- **Reason:** CaseGraphen already owns replay, evidence/review separation, operation gates, and loss-explicit projections; a second canonical memory store would split those guarantees.
- **Rejected alternatives:** an external memory product as source of truth, an embedded vector database, or agent-managed acceptance. These may serve as derived candidate/index components later, but cannot own accepted memory.

## What Changed / Blast Radius

- Adds an experimental Rust `memory` module and seven governed v0 contracts under `schemas/experimental`.
- Adds read/proposal-only CLI commands and 9 operational MCP tools; the MCP catalog grows from 19 to 28 tools.
- Adds `casegraphen-memory-query`, `-curate`, and `-audit` skills plus conformance/install gates.
- Adds ADRs, threat model, operating guide, and an Issue #92 dogfood corpus with 8 adversarial cases.
- Existing CaseStore, MorphismLog, review, operation-gate, and runtime semantics are unchanged. There is no migration or new durable store.

## Invariants

| Must stay true | Enforcement | Violation symptom |
|---|---|---|
| Only reviewed, source-backed Case Graph claims enter the current view | `src/memory/query.rs`, `tests/memory_plane.rs` | candidate/orphaned data appears as accepted memory |
| Summary/extraction cannot amplify authority, provenance role, or reduce sensitivity | `src/memory/authority.rs`, `src/memory/validation.rs` | external/tool/restricted data becomes a project constraint or leaks |
| Query filters run before relevance ranking; projections/indexes cannot mutate or substitute accepted state | `src/memory/projection.rs`, `src/memory/index.rs` | out-of-scope data leaks or a forged cache becomes authoritative |

## Failure Modes and Detection

| Pattern | Detection |
|---|---|
| stale, superseded, or not-yet-valid claim returned as current | bi-temporal and supersession tests in `tests/memory_plane.rs` |
| authority laundering, sensitivity downgrade, or unreviewed source relation | adversarial fixtures plus proposal/accepted-view fail-closed tests |
| projection/index content substituted while retaining a declared hash | projection Use Report and rebuild-equivalence tamper tests |

## Evidence

- [x] `rustup run 1.80.0 sh scripts/static-analysis.sh` — all repository gates passed on the CI/MSRV toolchain, including clippy, test suites, 48 experimental contracts, 20 product workflows / 28 MCP tools, pilot checks, and standalone crate packaging.
- [x] `cargo test --test memory_plane --test product_surface --test experimental_schema_conformance --test skill_conformance` — 19 Memory Plane tests plus MCP/product, schema, and skill boundary tests passed.
- [x] Dogfood report: `docs/pilots/issue-92/evaluation-report.v0.json` records zero violations for all six v0 safety counters and 8/8 adversarial cases.

## Rollout and Rollback

- **Rollout:** remains experimental and opt-in; create/query only project memory. Stable promotion is explicitly refused by ADR 0029.
- **Rollback:** revert this PR and discard/rebuild derived indexes. If operators have already accepted memory claims, preserve ledger history and use reviewed supersession/retraction rather than deleting log entries.

## Review Focus

- `src/memory/query.rs` and `validation.rs`: accepted-view, scope, temporal, authority, provenance, and sensitivity boundaries.
- `src/memory/projection.rs` and `index.rs`: filter-before-rank, loss reporting, and content-address integrity.
- `src/bin/casegraphen-mcp-host.rs`: read-only/proposal-only operational surface and artifact confinement.
- `docs/adr/0028-memory-plane-positioning.md`: responsibility boundary with ADR 0002.

## Unknowns

- Multi-session agent-runtime memory-action effectiveness and reviewer load are not measured. ADR 0029 makes this a stable-promotion blocker, not an experimental-v0 merge blocker.
- The vector adapter is intentionally not implemented; v0 has deterministic exact/graph/lexical retrieval and a rebuildable adapter boundary.
- Personal-data deletion semantics remain out of scope; v0 is restricted to project memory.

## Related

Closes #92
Closes #93
Closes #94
Closes #95
Closes #96
Closes #97
Closes #98
Closes #99

- Positioning: `docs/adr/0028-memory-plane-positioning.md`
- Design: `docs/design/memory-plane.md`
- Threat model: `docs/design/memory-threat-model.md`
- Operating guide: `docs/guides/memory-plane.md`
